g.text: Physical ERD - Communities and forum content (1 of 3)
Crow's-foot notation. PK primary key, FK foreign key, UK unique key.
FK <name>: the foreign key references a table that is not drawn here.
Dashed boxes belong to another diagram (key only).
UK*: partial unique index (unique only for rows matching its WHERE condition).
communities.name is not a UK: communities_active_name_key is a partial unique index
